response.short: ESC (Electronic Speed Controller) controls motor speed.
response.detailed: An ESC regulates power from the battery to the motors, controlling their speed based on signals from the flight controller.
bullets: Converts battery DC power into motor signals

response.short: Propellers generate thrust for the drone.
response.detailed: Propellers convert motor rotation into thrust, allowing the drone to lift and move.

response.short: KV defines motor speed per volt.
response.detailed: KV rating indicates how fast a motor spins per volt without load.
bullets: High KV → high speed, low torque
Low KV → low speed, high torque

response.short: Battery supplies power to the drone.
response.detailed: Drone batteries (usually LiPo) determine power, flight time, and performance.

response.short: Drone vibration is usually caused by mechanical or tuning issues.
response.detailed: Unstable flight often comes from imbalance or improper tuning.
